notes.title: Boom Face Update 1.00.03
notes.content:
Boom Face has been updated with some minor changes.

[list]
[*] Added a death animation for enemy snipers
[*] Fixed a bug which would sometimes cause the screen to flicker
[*] Fixed a bug in the Tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug with the shotgun spread
[/list]

notes.title: Boom Face Update 1.00.01
notes.content:
Boom Face has been updated with some minor fixes.

[list]
[*] A fix that was keeping the game from launching in some cases.
[*] Some physics / collision fixes.
[*] log.txt is now reset each time you restart the game
[*] You can no longer start a deathmatch or team deathmatch game with only one player.
[/list]
